name: ImgCompress
description: Offline image compression, conversion, and AI background removal for Docker homelabs.
composeYaml:
services:
  imgcompress:
    image: 'karimz1/imgcompress:0.6.0'
    environment:
      - 'DISABLE_LOGO=${DISABLE_LOGO:-false}'
      - 'DISABLE_STORAGE_MANAGEMENT=${DISABLE_STORAGE_MANAGEMENT:-false}'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:5000'
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3

meta.about: Image processing tool that runs entirely in Docker. Compress, convert, resize, batch-process images, and remove backgrounds using local AI without cloud dependencies.
